items.item: (1) J3, H16 (a): where the condition holds where relations close
items.how: Thesis and §3's opening carry the full form, each name checked in ConditionInTime.lean: read in time, with every occurrence a standpoint held de se along the relation in time, it fails over every step wherever there is a formation (Flow.not_unrestricted_inTime); read from some step on, it holds exactly where each one's acts, from every step, come to bear on every other's later continuation (Flow.unrestrictedEventually_iff_mutuallyDependentInTime, MutuallyDependentInTime being from every step); over every later step it asks more, coupling at every next step (Flow.unrestrictedAfter_iff_coupledEachStep); mutual dependence in time can hold from one step and not from the next (Drawing.lapses). §4's table (row 1), §4.7's 'The ethics keeps its form' and T8 carry the short form ('read in time, only from some step on, where each one's acts, from every step, come to bear on every other's later continuation', linked to §4.11). 'Over what comes after' is used only for «续无外于后» (TwoSources) and never joined with 'come to bear'. The AG reading in 'Within the whole map' says 'where relations close, read across all steps' with the in-time limit beside it.

'read in time it holds where each formation's acts, from each step on, come to bear on every formation's later continuation, and only from the steps where they do' is now 'in time, read from some step on, it holds where each formation's acts, from each step on, come to bear on every formation's later continuation; mutual dependence in time can hold from one step and not from the next (`Drawing.lapses`)', as J3 asked. J3's NOTE.md keeps its own wording. The stale "G3's" before `Flow.mutuallyDependent_iff_unrestricted` in §4.11's first bullet also dropped (the lemma now stands in FlowCenters).

Thesis, §3's opening and §4.5: 'Where the condition holds, on an acyclic relation every standpoint has the same center (`«续无外则同一中心»`); on a net going forward in time this comes from the condition's asking that nothing other than the center lie at or before the center's step (`«续无外当且仅当后与独»`, `«独则同一中心»`), and over what comes after two centers can meet it (`TwoSources.apart`)' (statements read in GrammarScope.lean:232 and ConditionInTime.lean:168, 183, 238). §4's table row 1: the short form with 'over what comes after two centers can meet it'. Kept as exact: the 'On its own carrier' bullets (§2, §3.2, §4.4: 'the condition forces every center to coincide', subject the condition); §3.5's law (two distinct centers, it is not the condition); §4.10's 'holds only where every center is one and the same occurrence' (subject the per-center condition). §4.10's dated reading made exact: 'along dated occurrences, a net going forward in time and so without cycles (`«后则无环»`), the line under the class of what can reach an occurrence is the occurrence alone (`«无环则返之所及唯己»`)' (OwnClass.lean:411); it is about that law, not the one-center result.

§1 table, row Read: 'what lies within its least boundary along a relation. A flow gives readings of the relation, the standpoints and the class (§4.8, §4.10); along affecting, at the formations whose acts return, given one, under each one's least class, the condition is then exactly mutual dependence (§4.13). Which relation, which standpoints and which class are readings; that significance is own closure is a reading' (checked against Flow.returning_downstream_iff_mutuallyDependent, which takes one returning formation). §3.3's last sentence: the AI reading kept on 'what the condition adds' (D18, D19), then the theorem forms: selection read off the centers' continuations or couplings does not reach it under §3.5's premises; with significance held de se as own closure at a center whose own closure lies within its coupling closure (as along affecting at the returning formations, for any coupling by level) nothing beyond that coupling closure has significance from it (§3.5, §4.13: Flow.ownClosure_rival_of_within, Flow.returning_beyond_coupling); pooled over every returning formation of a flow with finitely many formations and reach decided nothing lies beyond (Flow.returning_pool_covers), so the bound bites for a pool leaving some returning formation out. Consequently §3.5's two sentences describing §3.3's old wording now say '§3.3 reads, as an AI reading (D18, D19), what the condition adds: …, which, it read, neither feedback nor selection reaches' and '§3.3 now says it with these laws' (no theorem statement of §3.5 touched). §4.8: 'the four pieces are joined in [§4.13](#route-b-joined)'; "G3's" dropped twice.

items.item: (3) H11: 07 §7's Conditional label and C among the direction's hypotheses
items.how: Read Direction.lean (every theorem takes Priority, J1/J2; extension_iff_widens at line 90 is a theorem; Requirement.Handover.direction takes Priority on the tier frame) and FrontierFrames.lean:445 (Priority.comparison). Label now '(the continuation condition, J1–J4, correspondence E; moves compared by what their outcomes admit, where an extension is a widening, `Direction.extension_iff_widens`; J1/J2 give C wherever it is decided whether an extension adds a basic claim, `Priority.comparison`)'. §7's lead 'Given the continuation condition and an order ranking by widening' now 'Given the continuation condition and J1/J2, with moves compared by widening'. No other place in 07 lists C among the direction's or handover's hypotheses (§7's handover sentence already says 'every comparison meeting J1/J2'). The record alignment-direction-under-widening already says 'no theorem here takes C' (its progress[2] keeps 'C read as widening' as a dated progress item, E10).

items.item: (4) H12: C with its living parameter
items.how: Extension.lean:43, 57 read. §4, where C is first named: 'C names the requirement that an order rank each course above every course it widens (`Comparison`) where every claim is counted as living, as on level paths (`Web.paths_extension_iff_widens`); in general `Comparison` takes a reading `living`, and C requires that an order rank each course above every course it extends, keeping every claim the other realizes and realizing a claim counted as living that the other does not, so the short form holds only where every claim is counted' (the quoted short form kept verbatim so the dossiers, COLLECTIVE-DIRECTION, 08, the opening's draft and 29 crosswalk quotes still hold). Thesis: the short form with '(with every claim counted as living; in general, above every course it extends by a claim counted as living)'. §4.4 r-comparison-by-widening: 'since on level paths every extension, under any reading of `living`, is a widening, so ranking by widening meets whatever C requires there, and with every claim counted C requires exactly that each course be ranked above every course it widens' (Web.paths_comparison_widens' proof). §5's lead: 'an order meeting C ranks a course above each course it extends there …, and C asks nothing of any other pair'. §4.4: 'where each route to an order meeting C rests'; 'deciding mixed pairs, of which C asks nothing' (Pigou–Dalton). The title 'What would give C's order on a listing' kept: it is bound into check_becoming.py's receipt scope strings. Record comparison-by-widening's statement and does_not_show[2] say the same.

items.item: (5) H15: quantifiers, the path result, 'one way', the persisting clause
items.how: PremiseWitnesses.lean:314, 395, 412, 531 and PersistingChoices.lean:853 read. §4's table row 2: 'for every order on a fixed listing, exactly when every listed item is marked; with markings reading the closures, for every standpoint, listing and order, exactly when the condition holds de se'; the 'does not show' bullet says the same in place of 'exactly there'. 'One way' dropped as the path result's label everywhere in 07 (thesis, §4 lead, table, the theorem's bullet heading 'To C between listed level paths', the paragraph after it, §4.4's route sentence, §4.7, T8, 'does not show'), with '(the converse is not shown)' where the direction needed saying; 'one way' stays only for relations running one way (and 'widening is one-way', an asymmetric relation). The path result now says 'with admission decided, between two level paths whose admitted pairs fit in a finite list, so that their admissions end', and self-concern's own continuation is read 'as what lies within its center's reach' (thesis, §4 lead; the theorem's bullet names the marking covering the center's closure). 'For courses that go on forming without end it is not shown' is now 'the course of a line that persists without end never fits such a list (`Flow.persists_not_listsAdmitted`, §4.9), so there this route is silent' (thesis, §4 lead, table, theorem paragraph, 'does not show').

T8 and §4.7 now say 'a self-concerned order already ranks every widening above, since every continuation lies within its reach, on a finite listing and, with admission decided, between two level paths whose admitted pairs fit in a finite list, so that their admissions end'.

items.item: (10) The AG reading in 'Within the whole map'
items.how: Added, labelled [AI reading, AG, 10 November 2026]: the first of the joint selection's conditions, read on the flow as the rule still reading what lies beyond the shapers' share (§3.5), and 05's pooled couplings are ways of closing relations, making a loss return to the selector so that its own continuation reaches what it drains; where relations close, read across all steps, a self-concerned order, its own continuation read as its reach, already ranks every widening above what it widens on any listing (`Weighting.increasingInOwn_iff_increasing_of_unrestricted`); where they cannot, counting their loss is the step we offer. for_ren: 07 'Within the whole map' now carries a reading, labelled [AI reading, AG, 10 November 2026]: the joint selection's first condition (the rule still reading what lies beyond the shapers' share) and 05's pooled couplings are ways of closing relations, making a loss return to the selector; where relations close, read across all steps, a self-concerned order already ranks every widening above what it widens (Weighting.increasingInOwn_iff_increasing_of_unrestricted); where they cannot, counting the loss of those whose loss never returns is the step we offer. Its limits are in the same paragraph: reach read across all steps does not say which differences reach which selection, when and how strongly, and a rule that does not name a one-way dependent can still spare it. It joins the map for alignment to the ethics; it is a reading, not a theorem.

07's direction (§7) is now said as its Lean takes it: the continuation condition, J1–J4 and a correspondence, with moves compared by widening; C (`Comparison`) is no longer among its hypotheses, since J1/J2 give C wherever it is decided whether an extension adds a basic claim (Priority.comparison).

C is now defined with its parameter: 'C names the requirement that an order rank each course above every course it widens (`Comparison`) where every claim is counted as living …; in general `Comparison` takes a reading `living`, and C requires that an order rank each course above every course it extends, … realizing a claim counted as living that the other does not'.

'Seeing them is needed, and not enough' is now 'seeing them is needed for a choice to answer to their loss, and not enough' in 07 (thesis, T8; 'for a selection to answer to a loss' in 'does not show' and Open): a fixed restraint can spare a dependent never identified, so seeing is needed for a response to the loss, not for every sparing.

Where 07 said the ranking 'for courses that go on forming without end is not shown', it now says what is proved: the course of a line that persists without end never fits a finite list (07 §4.9), so there this route is silent. And 'where relations close' now has its time: read in time, the condition holds only from some step on, where each one's acts, from every step, come to bear on every other's later continuation, and it can lapse.
